task: P2-T13 — reset sidecar restart counter on readiness (attempt was a lifetime count, disabling auto-restart after 8 starts)

implementation.fix: In start()'s `Readiness::Ready` branch (src-tauri/src/sidecar.rs:653-655 post-edit), alongside the info write and before `Ok`/emit: `*state.attempt.lock().await = attempt_after_start(attempt, true);`
implementation.race_free_because: The reset lives on the same task/future that observed `Readiness::Ready`, inside start() itself — NOT in a spawned background task. The mutex write completes before start() returns Ok, so any subsequent `Terminated` event → spawn_log_pump → restart() necessarily reads the already-reset counter. Only one future ever holds the increment and the reset; no background task races a stale count.
